name: Station alarm timestamp interface
aliases: substations Substation automation and command interfaces
summary: Associates the source event time with its station alarm record.
description: Associates the source event time with its station alarm record. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Alarm event and time” at the input and “Time-tagged alarm” at the output. Reception time can differ from source event time.
